# Healthcare Quality Standards

This folder contains specific policy thresholds and national quality target benchmarks used to evaluate healthcare quality within the Danish clinical quality development framework. It documents the exact numerical standards applied to clinical indicators, such as the minimum acceptable treatment coverage rates for anticoagulation in atrial fibrillation patients and the maximum allowable incidence rates for severe bleeding complications. These pages define the mandated limits that regions and hospitals must meet to ensure patient safety and adherence to clinical guidelines.

## Pages

- [[standard-90-percent|"Standard: ≥90 %"]] — The national quality target benchmark requiring at least 90% treatment coverage for anticoagulation among atrial fibrillation patients.
- [[standarden]] — The specific policy threshold setting the maximum acceptable incidence rate of intracranial bleeding at ≤ 0.6% for prevalent atrial fibrillation patients.
